lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree.
Agree is a verb. No am.

data.why: Agree is a verb. No am.

native.tip: agree は動詞なので be 動詞はいりません。I agree でOK！
native.caption: “I am agree.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「賛成だ」につられて am を入れがち。agree はそれだけで動詞なので、I agree と言います。 “I agree.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“agree”。be 動詞は不要です。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Agree is already a verb, so no am is needed. Just say I agree.
en.caption: Do you say “I am agree.”? 😅 Japanese sansei da makes you add am. But agree is a verb by itself: I agree. The natural way is “I agree.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
